description: This file defines the ExecutionService class responsible for managing test case executions, including creating runs, starting runs, completing runs, and executing test cases asynchronously. It interacts with database models, a storage service for logs, and logging utilities.

classes.name: ExecutionService
classes.description: Service class providing methods for creating, starting, completing, and executing test runs asynchronously.

methods.name: RunHistory create_run(self, db: Session, case_id: str, user_id: str)
methods.description: Creates a new test run record in the database with pending status.

methods.name: start_run(self, db: Session, run_id: str)
methods.description: Marks a specific run as started, setting the start time.

methods.name: complete_run(self, db: Session, run_id: str, status: ExecutionStatus, log_content: str = None, error_message: str = None)
methods.description: Marks a run as completed with a final status, uploads logs if provided, and records errors if any.

methods.name: str execute_test_case(self, db: Session, case_id: str, user_id: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously executes a test case, creating a run and launching background execution.

methods.name: _execute_background(self, db: Session, run_id: str, case_id: str)
methods.description: Performs the actual test execution in background, simulating execution, and handling success or failure.

ctags.name: _execute_background
ctags.pattern: /^    async def _execute_background(self, db: Session, run_id: str, case_id: str):$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, run_id: str, case_id: str)

ctags.name: complete_run
ctags.pattern: /^    def complete_run(self, db: Session, run_id: str, status: ExecutionStatus, $/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, run_id: str, status: ExecutionStatus, log_content: str = None, error_message: str = None)

ctags.name: create_run
ctags.pattern: /^    def create_run(self, db: Session, case_id: str, user_id: str) -> RunHistory:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, case_id: str, user_id: str)

ctags.name: execute_test_case
ctags.pattern: /^    async def execute_test_case(self, db: Session, case_id: str, user_id: str) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (self, db: Session, case_id: str, user_id: str)

ctags.name: start_run
ctags.pattern: /^    def start_run(self, db: Session, run_id: str):$/
